**eval:** a deterministic non-building prompt fact-pack harness (`eval/fact-pack/`) runs the four arms — no-Pixel, current Pixel, automatic at-most-1 KiB packet, on-demand full JSON — over paired task families and applies the protocol's decision rule; the automatic packet is a read-only `pixel scope-task --read-only` read of a warm daemon, and no provider request is made without explicit setup.
